sources.supports: copyCasesToSection validates the section ID, sends it as the only path segment, forwards the JSON body unchanged and resolves with no value: TestRail answers 200 with an empty body, confirmed by the driver's live probe, so the copies are not returned.

CopyCasesToSectionPayloadSchema declares case_ids as an array of numbers and is deliberately separate from the delete payload so a change to one endpoint cannot spread to the other. It is a declaration only: the public method forwards the payload without parsing it, so the rule is enforced at the MCP boundary alone.
copy_cases_to_section/{section_id} copies the listed cases to another suite or section; section_id is the target and case_ids the list of cases.

input_policy.notes: Strictness is an MCP boundary requirement at every depth. The body carries only the case identifiers. TestRail's reference marks case_ids optional, but the driver's payload requires it and a copy without cases has nothing to do.

outer_result.notes: The method resolves with no value and the wrapper reports data: null; the copies must be listed afterwards. One request copies every listed case.

requirements.description: Reject unknown top-level fields before driver invocation rather than forwarding or discarding them.
Reject an unknown body field rather than forwarding it; the body carries case_ids only.
Send exactly one request, however many cases are listed. The adapter never splits the list or reads the copies back.

parameters.semantics: No coercion. The target section; passed positionally and sent verbatim as the only path segment.

wire.encoding: Decimal integer path segment; numeric strings are rejected rather than coerced.

parameters.semantics: No coercion. The JSON object is passed as the driver's second argument and sent unchanged.

requirements.description: Preserve the object at driver argument 1 as the JSON request body.
Accept an object carrying the case list.
Reject a body that is not an object before driver invocation.

parameters.semantics: The cases to copy. The driver forwards the payload unchecked, so the boundary holds every member to the identifier domain and requires at least one; the list is sent as a JSON array.

wire.encoding: JSON array of integers under case_ids.
